name: Service Health Check + Alerts

nodes.name: Send Telegram Alert
nodes.notes: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID must be set in .env.

notes: State file persists at /home/node/.n8n/health-state/health-state.json (volume-mounted to ./health-state on host). Without that mount, counters reset on container restart and alert debouncing breaks.
